ui.title: AI Businesses: 13 Ideas Ranked from Worst to Best for Getting Started — and the Ladder to Climb
ui.description: Thirteen businesses you can start with AI, evaluated by INEMA for technical demands, market opportunity, and durability. Plus a 6-question assessment, ready-to-use offers by industry, and a 90-day plan.
ui.hero_titulo: AI Businesses: from worst to best for getting started
ui.hero_lead: Thirteen businesses you can start with AI today, with INEMA’s scores for technical demands, market opportunity, and durability — and a path to move from one to the next.
ui.hero_alt: AI Businesses banner: from worst to best for getting started
ui.resumo: Every day, a new business idea built around AI appears, and choosing has become harder than building. This page evaluates thirteen of them with three scores from 1 to 5: how much technical knowledge you need to deliver something someone will pay for, how much room there is in the market (more buyers than sellers), and how long the business can last and grow without being swallowed by a platform. The list ranks them from worst to best for people just starting out. The rule that emerges at the end is simple: at the bottom, you sell what you build, which gets cheaper every month; at the top, you sell your judgment, which gets more valuable. That’s why the second part is a four-step ladder, with a 6-question assessment to find your step, a ready-to-use offer for each business, industry examples, and a 90-day plan. The prices in Brazilian reais are reference ranges for what people charge, not a promise of earnings.
ui.notas_sub: None of the businesses on this list are bad: they all work for someone. The scores show what kind of challenge you’ll face.
ui.n_tec_d: How much knowledge you need to deliver something someone will pay for. A high score means it’s harder.
ui.n_mer_d: Whether more people want to buy than are currently selling. A high score means more opportunity.
ui.n_dur_d: Whether it can become a business that lasts for years without being swallowed by a platform. A high score means it’s more resilient.
ui.rapido_sub: From 13th (worst for getting started) to 1st (best). Tap a business to see its full profile.

ui.regra_titulo: At the bottom, you sell what you build. At the top, you sell your judgment.
ui.regra_texto: Building websites, automations, or apps gets cheaper every month because AI does much of the work. Diagnosing the right problem, convincing a team to change, and being accountable for the result remain expensive because they depend on you. Starting at the bottom isn’t a mistake: that’s where you gain experience and your first clients. The mistake is staying there.

ui.escada_titulo: The AI Business Ladder: find your step and climb
ui.escada_desc: A 6-question assessment that suggests which AI business to start with, ready-to-use offers for each step, examples by industry (clinic, accounting, real estate, law, restaurant), and a 90-day plan.
ui.escada_lead: Answer 6 questions, find out which business to start with, and see the ready-to-use offer, first client, and next step.
ui.degraus_sub: The higher you go, the less you sell hours of building and the more you sell diagnosis and accountability. Clients from the lower steps are the same ones who will buy from you at the higher steps.

ui.setores_sub: Clients don’t buy “AI.” They buy fewer missed calls, more appointments booked, and less time spent typing. Choose an industry and see the offer for each step.
ui.plano_titulo: From zero to your first case study
ui.plano_sub: The plan works for any step. What changes is the offer you bring.
ui.foco_titulo: Choose one and stick with it
ui.foco_texto: People who succeed rarely chose the perfect business at the perfect time. They chose one, stuck with it long enough, and didn’t switch niches every three weeks. Use the assessment to decide, not to put it off.

ui.aviso: The prices are reference ranges for what people charge in Brazil (Brazilian reais, R$) in 2026, not a promise of earnings. Results depend on the offer, industry, execution, and time.

negocios.curta: The most talked-about and the hardest to start: building the app is easy; getting people to pay every month isn’t.
texto: You build software with help from AI and charge a monthly subscription for people to use it. The potential is enormous, it can grow with a small team, and that’s why it’s the business that shows up most often in success stories.

The problem is that building has become the cheap part. Thousands of apps launch every week, but people’s attention hasn’t grown. The real business is getting discovered, convincing people to pay, and preventing cancellations. As usage grows, security and infrastructure costs add up. And an app that’s just a shell around a model can die with the platform’s next update.
negocios.preco: R$ 29 to R$ 299 per month per client; you need hundreds of clients to make a living from it.
negocios.para_quem: People who already have an audience, a service business, or enough cash to get through months without revenue.
negocios.armadilha: Building before you have buyers. Most SaaS businesses that grow started as a service that was already selling.
comecar: Sell the solution as a hands-on service to 3 clients
Write down what repeats across all of them
Only then turn the repeated part into an app
negocios.oferta: I handle [task] for [type of company] for a monthly fee, with nothing for you to install.

rel.nome: Vibe Coding Immersion — from zero to SaaS
rel.d: From prototype to product with AI, step by step.
Agents that test whether an idea has buyers before you build it.

negocios.curta: Cheap to start and great for learning, but views alone don’t pay the bills.
texto: A YouTube, TikTok, or Instagram account where AI helps create the content and you don’t appear on camera. The startup cost is almost zero, and you can test several formats in a short time.

The money doesn’t come from views; it comes from people who want to reach that audience: sponsors, your own product, or a paid community. Mass-produced repetitive content isn’t monetized by platforms, and viral content without a defined audience won’t attract anyone willing to pay. First think about who watches and who would pay to reach them.
negocios.preco: Sponsorships from R$ 300 to R$ 5.000 per post when the audience is niche and engaged.
negocios.para_quem: People who want to learn to create with AI and are willing to build an audience for months before earning money.
negocios.armadilha: Choosing a topic based on what goes viral instead of who would pay to reach that audience. And the platform can change the rules overnight.
comecar: Choose a niche with clear advertisers (finance, health, tools)
Post 1 video a day for 30 days
List 10 brands that advertise in that niche
negocios.oferta: My channel talks to [audience] every day; your product reaches them for [price].
negocios.kpi: Niche followers and sponsorship price per post

rel.d: 16:9 video without a camera or avatar, with locally generated voice.
Find out what goes viral in your niche and make your own version.

negocios.curta: The best place for a beginner to start: quick, visual, and easy to show. But there’s a low ceiling.
texto: You build websites for small businesses in an afternoon using AI tools instead of taking weeks. You can put together a demo of the client’s own website before talking to them, which changes the conversation: they see it finished before paying.

Agencies still charge a lot for the old way of doing things, so you can enter at a lower price and deliver faster. The limit is that AI website builders cost just a few dozen reais a month, and the client will find out. Use this to build momentum, a portfolio, and your first clients, then move up.
negocios.preco: R$ 1.500 to R$ 5.000 per website, plus R$ 100 to R$ 300 per month for maintenance.
negocios.para_quem: Complete beginners who want a first client quickly and something visual to show.
negocios.armadilha: Selling only websites. It’s hard to get past a few thousand reais a month.
comecar: Choose 10 local businesses with a bad website or no website
Build a demo for 3 of them in 20 minutes each
Send the link and offer to publish it
negocios.oferta: I made a new version of your website; if you like it, I can publish it this week.
negocios.kpi: Inbound inquiries through the website per month

rel.d: References become a style, images, and a website ready to show.
Help the client’s website show up on Google and in AI searches.

negocios.curta: A great way to get inside a company and build trust, but hard to connect to a financial result.
texto: You bring the agents, automations, tools, and team knowledge together in one place: an assistant that knows the documents and processes and responds through the channel the company already uses.

It’s an excellent entry point because once clients trust you, they’ll buy larger projects. The weak point is measurement. Every offer needs a number the owner tracks (sales, hours, customer interactions), and a generic hub doesn’t move a clear number. It also only works if the owner already believes in AI; otherwise, the team won’t change its habits and you won’t have a case study.
negocios.preco: R$ 5.000 to R$ 20.000 for setup, plus R$ 800 to R$ 3.000 per month.
negocios.para_quem: People who already know agents and automations and have access to tech-friendly business owners.
negocios.armadilha: Selling the hub without tying it to a number. Without measured results, there are no referrals.
comecar: Choose a process with a clear metric (e.g., response time)
Build the hub just for that process
Measure the before and after for 2 weeks
negocios.oferta: I put everything your team asks about into one assistant, and response time is cut in half.
negocios.kpi: Hours saved per week across the team

rel.d: A foundation for running company agents in one place.
An assistant that works with the office’s files.

negocios.curta: It’s SEO for the ChatGPT era: money is coming in and few people are doing it, but you need to know how to prove results.
texto: You work to get a client’s brand recommended when someone asks ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or Perplexity a question. It’s an extension of SEO, a market that has existed for decades and that companies know they need to pay for.

People who already do SEO have a major advantage because they know how to measure and show results. Without that foundation, it’s hard to prove the change came from your work. And AI companies have started selling ads, which could change the rules about who shows up.
negocios.preco: R$ 2.000 to R$ 6.000 per month per client.
negocios.para_quem: People who already work in SEO, content, or digital marketing.
negocios.armadilha: Promising a position in an AI answer. Promise the work and show the measured progress.
comecar: Ask 3 AIs 20 questions about the client’s industry and note which brands appear
Fix the website, data, and pages the AI reads
Repeat the 20 questions after 30 days
negocios.oferta: Today, AI recommends your competitor when people ask about [service]. In 90 days, I’ll change that, and you can track the results.
negocios.kpi: How many of the 20 questions the brand appears in

rel.d: SEO + GEO method for Google, Bing, and AI searches.
Technical audits and AI search optimization with Claude Code.

negocios.curta: Demand keeps growing, but ready-made workflows have become a commodity. The value is in finding the bottleneck.
texto: You connect AI to the systems the company already uses: CRM, email, spreadsheets, invoices, WhatsApp. It’s where many people started and is still where service requests come from most often.

But building automations is getting easier and easier, and many companies already hire someone internally to do it. A one-off workflow is worth little. What matters is finding the most expensive bottleneck, tying the fix to a business result, and charging for that result — and that’s already the consulting step.
negocios.preco: R$ 1.500 to R$ 6.000 per workflow; more when charging based on results.
negocios.para_quem: People who like logic and tools and want a service with steady demand.
negocios.armadilha: Selling one workflow at a time and competing on price with thousands of people.
comecar: Ask the client which task takes up the most team time
Automate just that task and measure before and after
Use the result to sell a fix for the next bottleneck
negocios.oferta: Your team spends [X] hours a week on [task]. I’ll take that off their hands in 15 days.
negocios.kpi: Hours per week returned to the team

rel.d: Nodes, API connections, and RAG for building workflows.
Find where the business is losing money and show it in reais.

negocios.curta: You get paid to teach and leave the room as the company’s “AI person.”
texto: You teach a company’s team how to use AI in each person’s work, using their real cases. Most employees say they haven’t received proper training, and companies know it.

The bigger payoff comes later. In the room, you see the company’s problems and build trust immediately. A larger project often follows the workshop. Teaching is a skill you can practice, and you need to master the tools you teach.
negocios.preco: R$ 3.000 for a half day to R$ 15.000 for a full day with a large group.
negocios.para_quem: People who like explaining things, speak well in public, and already use AI in their own work.
negocios.armadilha: A generic “ChatGPT for beginners” workshop. Bring in the company’s own cases, or no one will use it the next day.
comecar: Build a 3-hour workshop with 5 real use cases for one industry
Run the first one for free or at a low price in exchange for a testimonial
Always finish with a diagnosis of what can be automated
negocios.oferta: In 3 hours, your team will leave using AI for [5 industry tasks], with materials to keep going.
negocios.kpi: People using AI at work 30 days later

rel.d: Prepare people and companies to adopt AI thoughtfully.
Turn what you know into a method you can teach.

negocios.curta: AI that handles WhatsApp, phone calls, and websites, books appointments, and hands off to a human. In Brazil, WhatsApp makes this business a top opportunity.
texto: AI responds to messages, phone calls, and website chat, answers questions, books appointments, and brings in a person when needed. The return is easy to explain: many calls and messages to small businesses go unanswered, and for a clinic, repair shop, or office, each one is a lost client.

In Brazil, where almost everything goes through WhatsApp, the pain is even more obvious. The risk is durability: the scheduling and customer service systems these businesses already pay for are adding their own AI. The winners will be people who know the industry and take care of setup, rules, and ongoing support.
negocios.preco: R$ 2.000 to R$ 8.000 for setup, plus R$ 500 to R$ 2.000 per month.
negocios.para_quem: People who want a service with recurring monthly revenue and results that are easy to show the owner.
negocios.armadilha: Selling the same generic AI to everyone. The system the client already uses will offer the same thing for less.
comecar: Choose an industry (clinic, repair shop, salon)
Build the demo around real questions from that industry
Show the owner how many messages went unanswered last month
negocios.oferta: None of your messages go unanswered, even at 10 p.m.; AI books the appointment and calls you when needed.
negocios.kpi: Messages and calls answered and appointments booked

rel.d: AI customer service for clinics: scheduling, questions, and follow-up.
WhatsApp leads are sent immediately to the available team member.
Gym: memberships, available classes, and WhatsApp check-in.

negocios.curta: Ads, videos, and carousels for brands. Anyone can hit “generate”; clients pay for taste and results.
texto: You create ads, commercials, carousels, and video edits for brands using AI. One person can do today what used to require a team and expensive equipment, and AI video editing is among the most in-demand skills.

The flip side is that anyone can hit the generate button, including inside the ad tools themselves, and the price per piece is falling. Clients pay for taste, for knowing which model works for which audience, and for using each ad’s numbers to make the next one better. If your ads sell, the client stays.
negocios.preco: R$ 2.000 to R$ 8.000 per month per brand, in a package of creative assets.
negocios.para_quem: People with a good eye for visuals who like video and want to track ad performance.
negocios.armadilha: Selling individual pretty assets. Sell a monthly package tied to campaign results.
comecar: Recreate 3 ads from a brand you admire
Offer a 10-piece trial package
Show the result of each piece and adjust the next one
negocios.oferta: Every month, you get [N] new ads, and I replace the ones that don’t sell with ones that do.
negocios.kpi: Cost per sale or per lead from campaigns

rel.d: Turn a script into carousels and stories ready to publish.
Create videos with code and locally generated voice, without paid generators.
Budgets, packages, and portfolios for selling production work.

negocios.curta: The clearest result on the list: more leads, more sales. If it works, no one cancels.
texto: You use AI to find companies and people showing buying signals, enrich the data, personalize outreach, and test far more messages than a human team could. You deliver meetings or qualified leads to the client.

It’s the “stickiest” business: if you bring in clients and your client makes money from them, they won’t cancel. The metric is the easiest to measure. The requirement is tough: you need to generate your own clients first, or no one will believe you can generate theirs. People who already have a prospecting agency and add AI have a head start.
negocios.preco: R$ 3.000 to R$ 10.000 per month, or a fee per meeting booked.
negocios.para_quem: People who like sales, numbers, and testing, and are willing to prove the method on themselves.
negocios.armadilha: Mass outreach without a clear purpose. It burns the domain, the client’s WhatsApp number, and their reputation.
comecar: Use the method to land your first 3 clients
Choose an industry and a buying signal (open job, new store, expansion)
Offer 30 days paid per meeting booked
negocios.oferta: I’ll put [N] meetings with [type of client] on your calendar each month. You pay for what happens.
negocios.kpi: Meetings booked and deals closed per month

rel.d: Find people showing buying signals and reach out at the right time.
Every incoming lead gets an immediate response.

negocios.curta: The most durable of all: people who trust you follow you when the tools change. But it takes years.
texto: Courses, community, newsletters, and videos, preferably with your face and voice. You need to work with the subject every day to teach it, or at least feel comfortable on camera. Competition is growing, but so is the audience that wants to learn.

It’s the most durable business because people invest in you, not a tool: when the technology changes, you change with it and they stay. The problem is the timeline. Building an audience takes years, and trust comes from proof. That’s why the common path is to provide services and consulting first, then use your brand to launch the other businesses.
negocios.preco: From one-off courses to a community subscription; it depends on the size and trust of the audience.
negocios.para_quem: People with hands-on experience to show, who enjoy teaching and can keep building over time.
negocios.armadilha: Starting with a brand before you have proof. First results, then trust, then an audience.
comecar: Document one real case you solved every week
Post on the same channel, on the same day, for 90 days
Bring anyone who responds to your own mailing list or group
negocios.oferta: Every week, I show how to solve [problem] with AI, using real cases.
negocios.kpi: People on your mailing list or in your community

rel.d: Organize what you know into a named method.
Publish consistently without spending all day on design.

negocios.curta: You’re the doctor: learn how the company works, find the bottleneck, and prescribe where AI will save the most.
texto: You go into a company, understand its processes, find the bottleneck, and identify where AI can save the most time or money. Fixes get cheaper every month; diagnosis still has value. And there’s the human part no AI can solve: convincing the team, setting usage rules, and helping people change their habits.

AI companies themselves have opened service divisions to deploy their tools in businesses, a sign that implementation is where the work is. Consulting pays sooner than education and opens the door to automation, customer service, and training projects.
negocios.preco: Diagnosis from R$ 3.000 to R$ 30.000, plus implementation.
negocios.para_quem: People who understand business, ask good questions, and have already delivered a few AI projects.
negocios.armadilha: Delivering a polished report and leaving. Clients pay for change, not for a PDF.
comecar: Offer a 1-day diagnosis for a fixed price
Deliver 3 opportunities with estimated savings in reais
Propose implementing the first one with a measurable target
negocios.oferta: In one week, I’ll show you where AI can save your company the most, in reais, and implement the first opportunity.
negocios.kpi: Reais saved or earned per month after implementation

rel.d: Trains AI consultants for small businesses.

rel.nome: AI Consulting: from diagnosis to delivery
rel.d: Diagnosis, solution design, pricing, delivery, and growth.
A kit for bringing AI to small and medium-sized businesses.

negocios.curta: The top step: take responsibility for a company’s AI strategy, or several companies’ strategies at once.
texto: There are two equally good paths. Become the AI lead at the company where you already work and take responsibility for its strategy and results. Or work as a fractional director, serving a few companies at once for a few hours a week each. This is often the natural next step for someone who has done consulting.

Large companies are creating this role quickly, and professionals with AI skills already earn more than their peers. It requires knowing enough not to be caught off guard and carrying yourself like an executive. The further AI advances, the more valuable it becomes to decide how to use it.
negocios.preco: Fractional: R$ 8.000 to R$ 25.000 per month per company. In-house: director-level salary.
negocios.para_quem: People with management or consulting experience and the trust of business owners and directors.
negocios.armadilha: Wanting the title without proof. It comes after measured results at other companies.
comecar: Choose 1 company where you already have trust
Propose a 90-day engagement with 3 AI-related business goals
Send the leadership team a monthly results report
negocios.oferta: I manage your company’s AI a few hours a week: strategy, tools, team, and results.

rel.d: Coordinate multiple agents and teams from one screen.
Agents that discover and validate business opportunities.

degraus.d: Visual things that are quick to show. Good for gaining experience and landing your first clients; prices fall every year.
Customer service, automation, creative assets, AI search. Recurring revenue and an easy-to-show metric.
Workshops, consulting, and lead generation. Pays better and opens the door to large projects.
AI director and personal brand. Takes longer to reach, but is harder to replace.

plano.d: Choose a business and an industry. Build the demo using a real client’s data, without asking permission.
Show the demo to 20 businesses in the industry. Land your first client, even at a low price, in exchange for a testimonial and numbers.
